title: Which hotel?
instructions: Sam ve Ayla iki otel arasında seçim yapıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; hangi özelliğin hangi otele ait olduğunu karıştırma.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: I've found two hotels for our trip to Rome. Can you help me choose?

script.speaker: sam
script.text: The first one, Hotel Sole, is in the centre, near all the famous places. It's a hundred and forty euros a night.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: That's expensive. And the other one?

script.speaker: sam
script.text: Villa Verde is cheaper, ninety euros, and it has a swimming pool. But it's thirty minutes from the centre by bus.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: At Villa Verde, yes. At Hotel Sole, no. Breakfast is fifteen euros each.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: Hmm. We're only there for three days, and we want to see a lot. I don't want to spend hours on buses.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: And we won't have time for the pool anyway.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: Exactly. Let's book Hotel Sole and have breakfast in a café. It's cheaper.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: Good idea. I'll book it tonight.

questions.feedback: Hotel Sole merkezde, ünlü yerlerin yakınında.
questions.evidence: is in the centre, near all the famous places.

questions.feedback: Villa Verde daha ucuz ve havuzlu ama merkeze otuz dakika uzak.
questions.evidence: and it has a swimming pool.

questions.feedback: Kahvaltı Villa Verde'de dahil; Hotel Sole'de kişi başı on beş euro.

questions.prompt: Why do they choose Hotel Sole?
options: They don't want to spend time on buses.
questions.feedback: Üç günde çok şey görmek istiyorlar; otobüste saatler geçirmek istemiyorlar.
questions.evidence: I don't want to spend hours on buses.
